company.name: Abdex Industries
company.tagline: Fluid transfer solutions up to 60,000 psi (4,135 bar)
company.description: A family owned and run business established in 1974. Abdex services the marine, offshore, defence, manufacturing, pharmaceutical and mining industries. Abdex offers low, medium, high and ultra high-pressure fluid transfer solutions up to 60,000 psi (4,135 bar) and an extensive variety of fittings, valves and instrumentation components, pressure test systems and hose manufacturing machinery. Facilities are equipped with assembly, testing and servicing equipment providing clients with specific hose assembly solutions.

services.name: Hose Testing and Assembly
services.description: Pressure testing and certification is a key element of what Abdex does. Abdex provides onsite inspection, assembling and pressure testing of hose assemblies. The dedicated service team handles hose assembly and certifies assemblies to the required working pressure.

services.name: Hose Management System (A-track)
services.description: Keeping track of high pressure assets is constant and often difficult work. The A-track system incorporates individual product etching and state-of-the-art RFID technology for tracking assets. You need to know what you have and where it is at all times.

services.name: Machine Service, Calibration & Training
services.description: Abdex offers a full training and installation service. We understand service and the need to keep machines working year after year. Service, calibration and training is available for Uniflex hose machinery and other equipment.

services.name: Rental Equipment
services.description: Abdex stocks a range of pressure control equipment. This equipment is available to rent at short notice with highly competitive rates. Ideal for projects that need equipment fast without capital purchase.

services.name: Umbilical Hose
services.description: Abdex has facilities for hose bundling (umbilicals) and Hydraulic Flying Leads (HFLs). Umbilical hoses bundle multiple hose lines together for subsea and offshore applications, providing a clean integrated solution.

common_questions.question: What pressure range do Abdex products cover?
common_questions.answer: Abdex offers fluid transfer solutions from low pressure right up to ultra-high pressure at 60,000 psi (4,135 bar). Our range includes hydraulic hoses, oil & gas hoses, high pressure valves, and ultra-high pressure tubing and fittings.

common_questions.question: Do you have BOP hoses?
common_questions.answer: Yes. Abdex stocks Blowout Preventer (BOP) hoses from Gates (Megashield 5000, 345 Bar) and Parker (2390N, 280-490 Bar). These are API16D certified hoses designed for hydraulic connections between well control equipment and control systems, rated for fire, high heat and safety critical applications.

common_questions.question: Are you the only certified API7K hose manufacturer in Australia?
common_questions.answer: Yes. Abdex is the only certified manufacturer of API7K drilling hoses in Australia. We offer a full range of rotary drilling hoses, slim hole rotary, and air drill hoses with matched fittings.

common_questions.question: What is the A-track system?
common_questions.answer: A-track is Abdex's Hose Management System. It uses individual product etching and RFID technology to track your high pressure hose assets — know what you have and where it is at all times. This is critical for compliance, maintenance scheduling, and inspection records.

common_questions.question: Do you sell Uniflex crimping machines?
common_questions.answer: Yes, Abdex is the authorised Uniflex distributor in Australia. We sell the full Uniflex range including the HM3H, HM220, HM380, HM450, HM660, HM1200, and the Ultra 2000 tonne crimper for large bore assemblies. We also provide machine service, calibration and training.

common_questions.question: What valve pressure ratings do you have?
common_questions.answer: Our high pressure valve range (Fitok and Alco brands) covers from 1,000 psi right up to 60,000 psi. Types include ball valves, needle valves, check valves, relief valves, metering valves, manifold valves, double block and bleed valves, and oilfield valves. Materials include 316 stainless steel, alloy 400, and 904L.

common_questions.question: Do you offer hose testing and certification?
common_questions.answer: Yes. Hose testing and certification is a core service at Abdex. We provide onsite inspection, assembly and pressure testing. We are NATA accredited and provide API certified hose assemblies.

common_questions.question: What industries does Abdex serve?
common_questions.answer: Abdex services the marine & offshore, defence, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, mining, oil & gas, and chemical processing industries. We have been operating since 1974.

common_questions.question: Do you have rental equipment?
common_questions.answer: Yes. Abdex stocks a range of pressure control and test equipment available for short-notice rental at competitive rates. Great for project-based needs without capital purchase.

common_questions.question: What Parker hoses do you stock?
common_questions.answer: Abdex stocks a wide range of Parker hoses including the Black Eagle series (5K, 10K, 15K), Parker BOP hose (2390N), Parker Aramid Braided hoses (2022N-5K, 575X-12, 2022N-10K), Parker Drilling Hoses, and the Parker No Skive P35-32. Parker is one of our key supply partners.

common_questions.question: What Gates hoses do you stock?
common_questions.answer: Abdex stocks Gates BOP hoses (Megashield 5000), Gates Rotary Drilling Hoses (Powerspiral 5000, 7500 Grade E), Gates Chemical Hose (Chem Master Plus XLPE), and Gates wire reinforced hydraulic hoses. Gates is one of our key supply partners.

common_questions.question: Where is Abdex located?
common_questions.answer: Abdex operates in both Australia and the United Kingdom. Contact us at info@abdex.com.au (Australia) or info@abdex.co.uk (UK). Visit our contact page at https://abdex.com/contact/
